name: Dia
description: Nari Labs' dialogue-focused zero-shot TTS engine (nari-labs/dia, Dia / Dia2) generating multi-speaker conversational speech with nonverbal cues. Self-hosted via a Gradio app (app.py) on port 7860, plus a pip library path with no listener. No authentication. Shodan http.html-blind (JS-rendered SPA); the app title 'Nari Text-to-Speech Synthesis' resolves via /config.
auth_notes: No authentication. app.py calls demo.launch(share=args.share) with Gradio defaults - host 127.0.0.1, port 7860, no auth= - so the bare default is loopback. However Docker and HuggingFace Space deployments routinely set GRADIO_SERVER_NAME=0.0.0.0 (and GRADIO_SERVER_PORT), which is how Dia instances reach the public internet. Gradio enforces credentials only when auth= or GRADIO_USERNAME/GRADIO_PASSWORD are set; neither is default. --share (default False) mints a public *.gradio.live tunnel. No rate limiting.

shodan_dorks.rationale: Dia serves a Gradio SPA; the gradio-app mount div is the reliable body marker since the Dia / 'Nari Text-to-Speech Synthesis' name is JS-rendered and not in http.html. Catches the surface on the canonical port for /config confirmation.
The served SPA shell references the Gradio config; combined with the canonical port this isolates Gradio surfaces to resolve via the /config JSON that returns the Dia app title.

Conjunctive: Gradio mount plus the inlined 'Nari' banner (the app heading is '# Nari Text-to-Speech Synthesis') isolates Dia from other Gradio TTS apps when config is inlined; otherwise fetch GET /config (returns 'Nari Text-to-Speech Synthesis') or use aimap deep-enum.

The full app heading string in the inlined config banner or /config JSON pins Dia specifically; combine with the /config 'version' field for Gradio-version/CVE scoping and to distinguish Dia from Dia2.

known_vulns: No auth on the Gradio UI - unauthenticated dialogue/voice-clone synthesis when bound to 0.0.0.0 (the standard Docker/HF-Space convention)
Gradio CVE-2024-1561 - arbitrary local file read via component routes on unpatched pins
Gradio CVE-2023-51449 - path traversal via /file= on Gradio 3.x < 3.47.0
Gradio CVE-2024-1727 - CSRF chain against /file and upload routes on Gradio 4.x pre-patch
SSRF via /queue/join upload proxy in the 2024 Gradio 4.x security batch
Unauthenticated GPU compute consumption - no rate limiting on inference by default
--share / community FastAPI wrappers add further unauth surfaces (POST /v1/audio/speech on ~8000)
risk_notes: Dia is the highest-profile project of the Gradio-TTS cohort (~19k+ stars, Dia2 released 2025-11-19). Its bare default binds loopback, but the standard Docker/HF-Space convention sets GRADIO_SERVER_NAME=0.0.0.0, which is how wild instances become internet-reachable. Vectors: (1) Unauthenticated dialogue TTS and voice cloning - Dia specializes in multi-speaker conversational speech with nonverbal cues, a high-fidelity deepfake/vishing surface; (2) GPU compute theft on the ungated inference queue; (3) File-read/traversal on instances pinned to a vulnerable Gradio version (CVE-2024-1561 / CVE-2023-51449) via /file=; (4) community FastAPI wrappers (multiple dia-fastapi / OpenAI-compatible forks) add a separate unauth POST /v1/audio/speech surface on ~8000 - ecosystem, not upstream. Shodan http.html is blind to the Dia name (JS SPA; title 'Gradio', mount div id='gradio-app', Server 'uvicorn'); the app heading '# Nari Text-to-Speech Synthesis' is DOM-injected, so identity resolves via GET /config (which returns that title string) or a JS-rendering crawl - not a body-string dork.
deployment_notes: ~19.4k stars, ~1.7k forks, Apache-2.0, not archived, active (HF Transformers support 2025-06-27, Dia2 released 2025-11-19). Two paths: the Gradio app (app.py, port 7860) and a pip/CLI library install (pip install git+https://github.com/nari-labs/dia.git) with no listener. Bare Gradio default is 127.0.0.1:7860; the common Docker/HF-Space convention sets GRADIO_SERVER_NAME=0.0.0.0 to expose it. No official Docker image (README lists ARM/macOS Docker as a TODO); community images and HF Spaces carry it. Community FastAPI/OpenAI-compatible wrappers exist adding POST /v1/audio/speech on ~8000 - flag as ecosystem, http.html-blind unless they add Swagger. Server header is 'uvicorn'. Because the page is a JS SPA, pivot on port 7860 plus the gradio-app mount and 'Gradio' title, then read GET /config to recover 'Nari Text-to-Speech Synthesis' and the Gradio version.
